_note: The per-effect canvas stories under src/blocks/extensions/motion/stories/ (Spec 38A §11, Spec 38 §9), one entry per story file. `stylesheet` is true when the story renders the effect's own runtime markup in the editor canvas and so needs `assets/css/fx-<effect>.css` there; includes/motion/class-sgs-motion-story-styles.php enqueues those, in the editor only. tests/js/motion-effects-panel.test.js fails when a story file has no entry or an entry has no file.
